description: Defines a class 'CalendarProviderType' representing an immutable value object for calendar provider configurations, including properties like name, authentication method, enabled status, class, and file.

classes.name: CalendarProviderType
classes.description: Represents a calendar provider type as an immutable value object with properties for name, authentication method, enabled status, class, and file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarProviderType object with specified name, auth method, enabled status, class, and file.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the calendar provider is enabled.

methods.name: getAuthMethod
methods.description: Returns the authentication method for the calendar provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the calendar provider.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class associated with the calendar provider.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the file associated with the calendar provider.
